identity.operation: Emit caller supplied gzip header fields through deflate.
identity.condition: A gzip wrapped stream has a header installed with deflateSetHeader.
identity.capability: Reach gzip initialization, deflateSetHeader, and custom header generation.
identity.consequence: The harness cannot exercise custom gzip header output.

requirement: When gzip compression is supported, the target's deflate operation should be able to reach custom gzip header generation through a valid stream and deflateSetHeader.

assessment.necessity_reason: Both versions can install and emit caller-supplied gzip header fields when GZIP is enabled. The complete old harness uses deflateInit and never calls deflateSetHeader. The opening guard for GZIP and its effective build setting are missing, so applicability under the fixed recipe is unresolved.

before.requirement: For a supported gzip-wrapped deflate stream, make caller-supplied header fields installed through deflateSetHeader reachable and emit them.
before.reason: Window bits can select gzip wrapping only under GZIP. If enabled, the fixed deflateInit call selects the default wrapper and the harness has no header-installation route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: GZIP guards selection of the gzip wrapper through windowBits.
deflateInit delegates to deflateInit2_ with the default window bits.

after.requirement: For a supported gzip-wrapped deflate stream, make caller-supplied header fields installed through deflateSetHeader reachable and emit them.
